description: Golden set for retrieval quality (ADR 0013). A question is answered at rank n when the n-th retrieved chunk belongs to one of its expected Capire pages. Questions that do not mention Java are answered for CAP Node.js, the assistant's default runtime. Negatives are questions the documentation does not cover; the retriever should abstain.
